parsed.rationale: Both records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists and no structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, and shared_ancestor are all null). The two files live in entirely separate app targets — `app:WatchXYC` (`WXYC/WatchXYC/RootTabView.swift`) and `app:iOS` (`WXYC/iOS/Views/Root/RootTabView.swift`) — which are platform-distinct entry points (watchOS vs. iOS). A shared name for a root tab view across two platform targets is a natural, intentional naming coincidence rather than accidental duplication; merging them would couple platform-specific UI hierarchies that must remain independent.
